title: Shift+Enter inside a list item or block quote nests the page break (Fable review F3)
description: Fable review F3. src/editor/pageBreakKeys.ts declines only in table cells; inside a listItem it inserts the pageBreak inside the item (probe JSON: listItem > [paragraph, pageBreak, paragraph]). src/editor/pagination.ts paginates top-level blocks only, so page view shows no new page, while src/export/document.ts visits list-item children and emits the break, so DOCX (pageBreakBefore) and PDF start a new page: editor and exports disagree. Decide one rule and apply it to listItem and blockquote (and any other wrapping block): either decline like the table-cell rule, or lift the break to the top level after the wrapping block. Fail-first: a Playwright case in tests/page-break.spec.ts (caret in a bullet item, Shift+Enter, assert the resulting JSON and the page count) and a unit case if a helper is extracted. Note the rule in docs/design-system.md Shortcuts via a DESIGN DOC note and docs/limitations.md if it is a limit.

review.note: Approved. Decline rule matches table-cell rule and the code; vitest src/editor 93/93 rerun by me; logs show fail-first failing and page-break pass. Did not rerun Playwright or native.

log.note: FIXED: Shift+Enter in a list item or block quote now declines (keeps soft break), same as table cells, so no page break is nested where page view ignores it but exports honour it. pageBreakKeys.ts: added isActive listItem / blockquote to the decline check; no schema change. Chosen rule: decline (T164 gave two options, no default; consistent with table-cell rule). Fail-first: two new tests in tests/page-break.spec.ts (bullet, quote) failed on old code (.manual-page-break count != 0), pass now. tsc clean; vitest src/editor 93/93; Playwright page-break 3/3; pages.spec 5/5 on rerun (first run hit the known F5/T165 ArrowDown flake 1846 vs 1848, passed on rerun). Logs: node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui3-t164. Not run: native WebKit. DESIGN DOC: Shortcuts: Shift+Enter inserts a page break at top level; inside a list item, block quote or table cell it stays a soft line break (page breaks are only honoured at the top level). Status CLAIMED, not verified in real use.
Approved. Decline rule matches table-cell rule and the code; vitest src/editor 93/93 rerun by me; logs show fail-first failing and page-break pass. Did not rerun Playwright or native.
